example.text:
我不提出新方向，只按你已经确定的技术路线（单 HTML + three.js 程序化建模）执行。唯一需要你知道的取舍：

**CDN 依赖 vs 完全离线**——单 HTML 且不内联 three.js，就必须联网从 CDN 加载 three。我会锁定单一版本（three@0.160.0 的 importmap，three 与 examples/jsm 同版本），并在页面上做加载失败检测：CDN 不可达时显示明确提示而不是白屏。如果你要求完全离线，请告诉我，我改用内联方式。

先探测环境（工作目录、node/curl、可用浏览器、CDN 可达性），再写代码。

<｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>
<｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke name="run_code">
<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="code" string="true">
const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
const [pwd, node, edge, chrome, cdn] = await Promise.all([
  tools.bash({ command: 'pwd && echo "---" && ls -a | head -5', description: 'Show working directory' }).catch(e => 'ERR ' + e.message),
  tools.bash({ command: 'node -v; which node; which curl', description: 'Check node and curl availability' }).catch(e => 'ERR ' + e.message),
  tools.bash({ command: 'ls -d "/c/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe" "/c/Program Files/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe" 2>/dev/null', description: 'Look for Edge browser' }).catch(e => 'ERR ' + e.message),
  tools.bash({ command: 'ls -d "/c/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" "/c/Program Files (x86)/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" 2>/dev/null', description: 'Look for Chrome browser' }).catch(e => 'ERR ' + e.message),
  tools.bash({ command: 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w "unpkg:%{http_code} " -m 20 "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "jsdelivr:%{http_code} " -m 20 "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "jsm:%{http_code}\\n" -m 20 "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js"', description: 'Test three.js CDN reachability' }).catch(e => 'ERR ' + e.message),
]);
out.pwd = pwd; out.node = node; out.edge = edge; out.chrome = chrome; out.cdn = cdn;
return JSON.stringify(out, null, 1);
</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>
<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="description" string="true">Probe working dir, node, browsers, CDN reachability</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>
